name: wosh-host-test
description: M1 conformance harness: the engine component (jco-transpiled, wasi served by preview2-shim) driven from node against real mosh servers over loopback UDP.

scripts.transpile-client: node jco-transpile.mjs transpile ../client-core/composed-client.wasm --name composed-client --async-mode jspi --map 'polymorph:webcrypto/*@0.1.0=../../.deps/polymorph-iroh/.deps/webcrypto/js/jco/webcrypto.js#*' --map 'polymorph:webrtc-datachannels/connections@0.1.0=../../.deps/polymorph-iroh/.deps/webrtc/jco-impl/webrtc.js' --map 'polymorph:websocket/connections@0.1.0=../../.deps/polymorph-iroh/.deps/websocket/js/jco/websocket.js' --map 'wasi:clocks/monotonic-clock@0.3.0=@bytecodealliance/preview3-shim/clocks#monotonicClock' --map 'wasi:sockets/*@0.3.0=@bytecodealliance/preview3-shim/sockets#*' -o generated-client
